purpose: Sovereign process supervision: how a CYNIC principal keeps a supervised subject alive, stops it cleanly, and proves both. Continuous convergence at runtime — distinct from deploy-time activation (contracts/runtime-update.json), which is a bounded operator act.

outer_owner.statement: The host service manager (systemd, OpenRC) remains the outer lifecycle owner of CYNIC daemons and is never supervised by CYNIC itself. No supervisor-of-supervisors regress.

vocabulary.role: A named supervised responsibility (e.g. inference-backend, node-control). The unit of supervision; never a bare pid.
vocabulary.subject: The process (or service unit) currently incarnating the role. Subjects are replaceable; roles persist.
vocabulary.supervisor_kind: The backend executing spawn/stop/probe for the role. Closed set, measured from code:

exit_reason.statement: Pure domain verdict on why a subject ended.
exit_reason.note: Recorded decision (crates/cynic-node/tests/architecture_boundary.rs): the supervision outcome type lives in the node domain layer, not in L0. The protocol owns the kind vocabulary; the node owns the outcome.

vocabulary.read_back: A supervision claim is true only when an observation of the subject reports it. Exit code 0 of the supervising command is not proof.

rules: Signal the process group, never the bare pid (Unix: group leader; Windows: JobObject).
KillOnDrop (or equivalent) is mandatory so no supervisor exit orphans a subject.
Every wait carries a hard timeout; every spawn carries a hard startup timeout.
Stdio of a supervised child is inherited, never piped without a draining reader (pipe-buffer deadlock).

backoff.policy: Exponential backoff with min-uptime stability reset: a subject that lived longer than min_uptime resets the attempt counter; attempts past max_attempts stop the role as Fatal, never loop forever.
backoff.rule: Backoff sleep is cancellable by the shutdown signal; shutdown never waits out a delay.

observation.loop: Every supervised role runs the contracts/observability-loop.json five stages: observation (probe the subject) -> evaluation (against desired state) -> action (bounded admit) -> proof (read-back) -> learning (thresholds).
observation.evidence: Observations are schema'd evidence (cynic-host ServiceSupervisorObservation pattern: subject, supervisor_kind, active/degraded/unknown counts). Unknown is an explicit state, never an absence of data.
observation.surface: Operator read-back exposes per-role supervision state (actively_supervised is true only when the selected supervisor's observation reports state=active). Precedent: crates/cynic-cli/src/operator_status.rs.

restart_vs_supervise.statement: Deploy-time restart (runtime-update.json: restart declared units, probe health, roll back on failure) and runtime supervision (this contract: continuous keep-alive with backoff) share vocabulary but never share code paths.
restart_vs_supervise.deploy_restart: Operator act, bounded, health-proven, rolled back. Executor: deployment pipeline.
restart_vs_supervise.runtime_supervision: Continuous convergence, backoff-bounded, Fatal-terminating. Executor: the owning daemon or the host service manager.
restart_vs_supervise.prohibition: No deploy pipeline step may delegate to a runtime backoff loop, and no supervision loop may switch releases.

prohibitions: No double-fork/daemonize: supervised subjects run in foreground under the supervisor (Type=simple semantics).
No sh -c / bash -c spawn: typed argv vectors only.
No supervisor without read-back: a role whose subject cannot be probed is reported unknown, never assumed active.
No unbounded restart: every loop ends in Fatal past max_attempts.
No pidfiles as liveness truth: a pidfile is inventory, liveness comes from observation.
No supervision of the outer owner: the host service manager is observed, never managed.

convergence_map.note: Fragments measured 2026-10-21 that this contract converges. Each row names the fragment and the clause that now owns its behavior.

rows.clause: vocabulary.kinds + observation.evidence; L0 owns the closed kind set and the pure status predicate, execution stays in adapters
stop_ladder + backoff; to be generalized from pub(crate) to the shared execution path without renaming behavior
vocabulary.exit_reason + runtime_supervision; the node-local incarnation of the loop
vocabulary.kinds + observation; the inference-local incarnation, converging onto the closed kind set
observation.evidence + outer_owner; host-side observation of both managed subjects and external processes
outer_owner; the boundary this contract never crosses

deferred.cynic_supervise_surface: A `cynic supervise` operator surface (converge/inspect a declared role) is the intended projection of this contract but is NOT specified here. Adding it is a separate slice: contract clause first, then pure types, then surface. No CLI verb may precede its clause.
deferred.shared_execution_crate: Whether the generalized spawn/stop/backoff path lives in cynic-host, a dedicated crate, or stays duplicated per consumer is undecided and awaits the crate_justified measurement (consumers >= 2, distinct change schedule). No new crate is created by this contract.
